_meta.spec: Trading Bot — Falsification-Hardened Specification v4, Section 1.1
_meta.note: Every field below is a LOCKED risk/execution parameter per v4 Section 1.1: it carries a version-locked definition and a timestamp predating any results that would justify it. Do not edit a value here after seeing how it performs — that is exactly the unfalsifiable practice this registry exists to prevent. To change a locked value: pick the new value BEFORE observing new results under it, update it here with a fresh locked_at timestamp and rationale, then deploy. tick.py hard-refuses new entries (WAIT) if its live constants don't match this file's hash.

HARD_SL_FRAC.rationale: Hard-close at market at 12% adverse move — inside the ~9.5% liquidation threshold at 10x leverage, so it fires before liquidation math would, and well outside normal 1m noise on NEARUSDT. Replaces the prior no-SL design.

MAX_POS_AGE_HOURS.rationale: Hard age ceiling. TP_AGING (below) only relaxes the profit target with age; it never forces an exit. This is the actual forced exit the prior design lacked.

SL_ATR_MULT.rationale: INHERITED FROM PRE-v4 GRID SEARCH (1152 configs) — flagged, not re-derived. Chosen by picking the value that performed best on the same backtest data (grid-search-on-results). This is the exact practice v4 Section 1.1 prohibits for locked parameters. Retained as-is for continuity; NOT re-certified under v4 discipline. Any future change to this value must be locked before seeing new results, per this registry.

TP_SL_RATIO.rationale: Same inheritance caveat as SL_ATR_MULT — pre-v4 grid-search origin, not re-derived under v4 discipline.

SCALP_TP_ATR.rationale: Pre-v4 two-week lab sweep result. Same inheritance caveat.

LEVERAGE.rationale: Locked leverage per spec Section 8.3 ("leverage is locked and versioned").

MARGIN_BUDGET.rationale: Owner-set, 2026-09-07 watch-period value; live-plan target noted as 0.40 in comments but not yet switched.

SAFE_DD.rationale: Realized-drawdown wall pausing new entries only — does not cap floating/unrealized exposure. Superseded in practice by HARD_SL_FRAC + MAX_POS_AGE_HOURS for existing positions.

TP_AGING_TIERS.rationale: Target relaxation only, never a forced exit — see MAX_POS_AGE_HOURS.

known_gaps_not_claimed: Tier 0 exchange-native resting/placeable stop order — this bot places no real orders on any venue; every kill is a software monitor polling every ~15s.
Tier 1 independent watchdog (separate host/network path/API credentials) — single GitHub Actions process, single Bitget public API path, no second host.
Tier 2 hedge/offsetting order with stress-tested basis risk — no hedge instrument is traded.
Tier 3 venue-level account kill / dead-man's switch — not available for a read-only public-API paper sim.

Regime probability engine (R(t), entropy, transition-risk), Probability Engine calibration+sharpness, Independent Uncertainty ensemble — not implemented; current entries use deterministic EMA/ATR/color rules only.

Hypothesis Registry with N>=200 independent events per regime, FDR/Deflated-Sharpe on total N, single-use Vault with retirement rule, block-bootstrap CPCV validation — not implemented; sweep.py/research.py perform grid search directly against backtest results, which v4 Section 1.1 explicitly treats as unfalsifiable, not as a passing validation protocol.
